6-tier equip requirements; per-group and per-damage-kind run multipliers (Phase 4 card hooks) reset each run.
New shared, stateless WeaponStats resolver (raw_stat/get_stat/resolve_def/roll_crit) — single source of truth for weapon numbers used by both weapon_system.gd (main scene) and the new arena engine.
Delegate stat/equip/crit math to WeaponStats so the main scene and arena cannot diverge. Behavior preserved (thin wrappers).

Equipment-driven world-space firing engine: reads equipped primary/secondary weapons via WeaponStats and auto-fires them, dispatching every fire_mode (repeat/charge/beam/channel/aura/orbital) and fire_type (projectile/cone/homing/chain/radial/splash_melee/hitscan_beam/tether/growing_zone/minion/orbital/parasite_blob/acid_cloud). radial + splash_melee are the two new behaviors. Run-card multipliers + crit fold in here.
Instantiate the loadout engine alongside the existing arena_weapons (fallback).
Stand down the default Gatling when an inventory primary weapon is equipped, so the two firing paths don't stack.

entries.changes_summary: Foundation phase of turning the arena into a run-based roguelite. Data layer: 6-tier rarity replacing the old 4 tiers (epic->rare remaps; legendary hulls re-tiered), a 6-group weapon taxonomy (ballistic/energy/hybrid/explosive/area_dot/summon) with damage_kind tags, 20 standard weapons (13 existing + 7 new) and 10 fragment-crafted uniques carrying their fragment lists. Logic layer: extracted a shared WeaponStats resolver so the arena and main scene compute identical damage; added GameManager group/kind run-multiplier hooks. Firing: a new arena_loadout.gd reads equipped inventory weapons and fires them in world-space (unifying the arena with InventoryManager per the approved plan), with arena_weapons.gd kept as the default/fallback gun.

New hub scene (now the boot scene) lets the player spend coins on blueprint weapons, assemble fragment-complete uniques, track fragment collection, and buy permanent passives; the inventory/equip UI is hosted in both the hub and the arena (was main-scene only). entries.changes_summary: Bosses now pay out. On boss_defeated the new salvage UI rolls weapons (rarity capped by an escalating per-run boss index so early bosses can't drop top-tier gear) plus a high-chance unique fragment drawn only from pieces you don't yet own (rank-gated by boss depth, never re-dropping owned pieces). Each weapon offers Equip-for-the-run (added + auto-equipped, flagged run-temp and sold off at the next run start) or Disassemble (permanently unlocks its blueprint in the hub shop). MetaManager gained the rarity-capped boss-weapon roller, the rank-gated fragment roller, and the run-temp mark/purge lifecycle (persisted so a mid-run quit still cleans up).

entries.changes_summary: The level-up draft is now build-defining. Added group-damage cards (Ballistics/Energy Flux/Hybrid Core/Ordnance/Saturation/Legion), damage-kind cards (Incendiary/Radiance/Impact/Ionize/Detonation), mechanic cards (Conductor +chain, Ricochet, Piercing Rounds, Overpressure +splash, Resonance +AoE, Rebound +bounce range), and combo cards (Overcharge/Demolition/Velocity/Momentum Drive) that pair a group buff with a mechanic. Cards feed GameManager.upg_group_dmg/upg_kind_dmg/upg_mech (all reset each run); the arena firing engine reads the group/kind damage mults (already wired in Phase 1) plus the new mechanic bonuses (chain jumps, ricochet, pierce, splash radius, AoE radius). ~31 cards total, drawn 3-at-a-time on level-up.

entries.changes_summary: Added the support-system trio. Drones: 5 archetypes (combat shoots via drone_damage_mult + kind, defend pushes enemy bullets away, repair heals over time, collect magnetizes XP orbs, lucky sets a live run_luck that raises drop/coin/fragment chance), 10 defs across 2 tiers, equipped in drone_1/drone_2 and run by the loadout engine (orbiting visuals). Thrusters: 4 modes read by the arena player controller (strong speed, reverse backpedal boost, smart auto-dodge using a new enemy-bullet query, defend bullet-push). entries.changes_summary: First balance tuning of the new arena roguelite. Fixed the crit baseline (test 20% → 0; arena keeps an intentional 10% base). Trimmed the heavy/turret enemies (sentinel/missile/centipede/octopus/bomber) so they stop being time-sinks against base weapons, while leaving the already-fast early swarm unchanged. Cut boss HP ~25-30% toward 30-60s fights (all boss HP flows from ENEMY_DEFS; the Elephant reads def.hp). Amped four swarm waves for the 'overflowing' feel. Bumped the underweight Acid Sprayer DoT. Documented everything in design.md including a full 30-weapon DPS reference table (with roles + outliers to monitor like Prism Array/Plasma Drill/Rift Maker) and the exact knobs to re-tune. All values are explicitly first-pass pending playtest.
